model.description: BUILT: populateRepos seeds each repo selector's sel.value from its side's st.repo AFTER filling the async-fetched <option>s. Root cause = RACE: openFromParams (f52b6941) set left+right st.repo + ran a .de-repo forEach, but populateRepos fills options async (fetch /api/git/repos) AFTER, so the pre-set sel.value had no matching option and reverted to default RawBin -> Tron saw NEITHER selector seeded. Fix seeds after options exist. Expert places [impl:uuid:2b7edf20-8a5f-4a3e-9ba8-2a78ff6d4df3] on the populateRepos decl (source-only, name-match). openFromParams sets the intent; the DOM-seed fix lives here.
